text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are Worldwide Windy—the<n>whirlwind that bites
the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These two go by the name<n>"Worldwide Windy."
They go around<n>day and night, offering guidance to
the troubled... Supposedly, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Most of their activity is shrouded in<n>mystery. They
called me into their<n>classroom because they wanted
to<n>talk about something, but what could<n>it be?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to our special emergency<n>meeting. We've
been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Today, we got something real<n>important to do.
That's right... we<n>needa come up with a new
signature<n>pose!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! A good pose is crucial<n>if we want
those who are lost and in<n>need of assistance to
lend us their<n>ears!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The key to connecting with the hearts<n>of those lost
little lambs is all about<n>having a striking signature
pose<n>when we show up on the scene!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And that's why we want to hear your<n>unbiased
opinion on what we come<n>up with. Thanks in
advance! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My vote's for a cool pose! That'll be<n>sure to get
everyone lookin' our way!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I propose a pose that would shake<n>people's souls.
People are more<n>receptive to suggestions when
they're feeling moved!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: Which one do you think is best?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their ideas are good, but they both<n>feel like they fall
a little short. Neither<n>of them perfectly captures their
true<n>charm, so I let them know my honest<n>opinion.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrk! So we're back to square one?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It might be good to broaden our<n>horizons a bit. Let's
head out and see<n>if we can find some inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We really gonna find inspiration out<n>here? All I see
is birds flyin' around.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Birds... Oh, how about we pose with<n>our arms
spread out like wings to<n>symbolize us soaring
around the<n>world?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, that's kinda lame.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're a tough customer! But that's<n>precisely what
I like about you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinkin' we go more intense!<n>Something like
this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And then a little bit of th—argh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy gets her legs tangled<n>and falls over!
But just as she's<n>about to hit the ground—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh no you dooon't!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What just happened?! It felt like I<n>just started
levitating!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I simply twisted my body and<n>scooped you
into my arms while<n>doing so.
choice_data_list: You looked just like a whirlwind!
You looked just like a whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: A whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Let's use that spin just<n>now as our
pose! After all, we're the<n>whirlwind that bites the
world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's mega on-brand and it's gotimpact!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Cept it sucks 'cause there's no<n>actual bitin'
involved...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's an easy problem to solve! We<n>can do a big
chomp at the end after<n>we're done spinning like the
wind!<n>C'mon, let's try it out!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: We are Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: The whirlwind that bites the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's it! We did it! I can't wait to<n>show it to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, this is the pose we've been<n>looking for!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A new wind blows across the land,<n>saving all the
little lambs. We're biting<n>back against the world's
conventions!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's keep practicing our<n>pose so we can
make it look super<n>awesome!
choice_data_list: You should make the wind movement faster.
Make sure to add a lot of oomph to that bite!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How's this?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Time to spin!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoa... The world... the world's<n>spinnin'...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not it! We're the ones<n>spinning the
world around! In other<n>words...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's us at the center of the world!<n>Someday, we'll
bring forth a mighty<n>whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As they practice, their spinning<n>gradually gets faster
and faster. At<n>this rate, they might actually generate
a whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If our pose lacks power, it'll make<n>our words
sound weak and<n>unconvincing too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Let's get to training! Let's work on<n>holding our
pose for as long as we<n>can!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ngh... hold on just a little more!Aaand... whew! Huff, huff... We did it!
choice_data_list: Why would you push yourselves so hard?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you listening to me earlier?<n>Our pose is the
key to opening<n>people's hearts. If we truly want to
reach people, we have to be serious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All you lost little lambs—just you wait!<n>We will show
you the way! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as Worldwide Windy is here,<n>the lost lambs
of the world can rest<n>easy... probably, at least!
